title: Mr Wildfire's Modpack
description: A custom tactical survival pack featuring firearms, base defence, beautiful biomes, and vast open cities.
body:
# Wildfire's Customised Survival

Welcome to a uniquely tailored Minecraft experience! Created and finely tuned for my friend Wildfire, this modpack blends tactical combat, high-tech base defence, beautiful exploration, and a creeping sense of dread. 

Because this pack was built around a specific playstyle, **I highly recommend tweaking the configuration files to fit your personal preferences** once you install it!

### 🗺️ Key Features & Featured Mods
* **Modern Guns** (by gamingbarn): Tactical firearm mechanics. My personal favourite gun mod!
* **SecurityCraft** (by Geforce132): Protect your base from mobs (and friends) with lasers, cameras, and traps.
* **The Lost Cities** (by McJty): *Adds some of the most beautiful cities in Minecraft*
* **Corpse** (by henkelmax): Never lose your items to a 5-minute despawn timer again. Your gear is safely stored at your death point.
* **Biomes O' Plenty** (by Forstride): Overhauls the world generation with gorgeous, immersive new biomes to explore.

### ⚙️ Performance & Optimization Notes
* **RAM Allocation:** We highly recommend allocating **4GB to 6GB of RAM** in your launcher settings for a smooth experience.
* **Shaders:** This pack includes intensive shaders. If you experience frame drops, we recommend tweaking the shader settings down a bit in-game.
* **Cities:** By default, the cities may be turned off or set to a version where they can make the game lag significantly. Please adjust this when making a world.

---

**Thanks for playing!** This is just the beginning—I plan to add way more content, features, and optimisation updates in the future.
